description:
In repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/feature-compose.ts, replace one line.

Find this exact text:

```
      .filter((c) => (c?.result as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)?.applied === true)
```

Replace it with exactly this:

```
      .filter((c) => String(((c?.result as Record<string, unknown> | undefined)?.new_git_sha) ?? "").length > 0)
```

Reason: this filter computes landedVessels, which now feeds the compose grade itself. It tests result.applied === true, but that field is never set true by the cutover — the landing path returns new_git_sha and push_status instead. Measured: landed_vessels is present on 1034 feature_compose rows and non-empty on zero of them, so the grade is permanently false and the learning loop receives only beta updates. Keying on new_git_sha uses the field the cutover actually emits when it lands.

Verify with bun run lint in repos/development-vessel.
